name: pydantic-settings 12-factor secrets
short_definition: pydantic-settings BaseSettings loads typed application configuration from environment variables, optional .env files, and secret files (Docker/K8s secrets_dir), validating at process start so misconfig fails fast — the 12-factor config pattern for FastAPI/workers.
scope_in: BaseSettings SettingsConfigDict env_prefix env_file secrets_dir SecretStr nested env_nested_delimiter settings_customise_sources frozen settings; dotenv filtering; priority of sources (init > env > dotenv > secrets depending on customisation); test overrides via constructor kwargs; production vs local loading policy.
scope_out: Pydantic BaseModel request DTOs (py-pydantic-v2); full secret managers SDKs (Vault/1Password runtime fetch beyond file/env injection); CLI frameworks as primary UX (typer may wrap settings); dynamic runtime reconfiguration without restart; feature-flag systems.
defaults: Single Settings(BaseSettings) module, frozen=True, loaded once at lifespan startup. SettingsConfigDict(env_file='.env' only for local/dev, env_file_encoding='utf-8', extra='ignore' for dotenv noise or scoped dotenv_filtering, env_nested_delimiter='__', validate_default=True). Secrets as SecretStr. Required fields have no insecure production defaults (DB URLs, API keys). Optional non-secrets may have safe defaults (log_level='INFO'). Prefer env over committed .env. In production containers: real env + secrets_dir; do not bake .env into images. Cache with @lru_cache or module-level singleton get_settings(). Nested submodels inherit BaseModel, not BaseSettings. Prefix service env with APP_ or service name.
decision_gates: USE for process-wide config (DB DSN, Redis URL, auth secrets, feature toggles from env). DO NOT USE for per-request user input (that is BaseModel). DO NOT put mutable operational state in Settings. Prefer secrets_dir / platform secret injection over long-lived plaintext in .env committed to disk. Prefer explicit Field(validation_alias=...) when renaming env keys. Use settings_customise_sources only when adding Vault/SOPS/custom sources — keep default order otherwise. If only 1–2 env vars in a script, os.environ.get is fine; if ≥3 typed fields, use BaseSettings.
do_dont: DO: fail fast on missing required secrets; SecretStr for keys/passwords; get_settings() with lru_cache; override in tests via Settings(db_url=...) or monkeypatch env; document env vars in README/.env.example without values; use env_nested_delimiter='__' for nested models. DON'T: commit .env with real secrets; default production API keys to 'changeme'; print(settings.model_dump()) of SecretStr without care (use get_secret_value only in sinks); reload Settings on every request; use class Config V1 style; require .env file in production; store mainnet keys or seed phrases in env on this machine (dev-only/devnet policy); parse secrets in shell scripts into process lists unnecessarily.
code_skeleton:
from functools import lru_cache
from pydantic import Field, SecretStr, PostgresDsn
from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings, SettingsConfigDict

class Settings(BaseSettings):
    model_config = SettingsConfigDict(
        env_file='.env',
        env_file_encoding='utf-8',
        env_prefix='APP_',
        env_nested_delimiter='__',
        extra='ignore',
        frozen=True,
    )

    environment: str = 'local'
    log_level: str = 'INFO'
    database_url: PostgresDsn
    redis_url: str = 'redis://localhost:6379/0'
    api_secret: SecretStr
    supabase_url: str | None = None
    supabase_service_role_key: SecretStr | None = None

    @property
    def is_prod(self) -> bool:
        return self.environment == 'production'

@lru_cache
def get_settings() -> Settings:
    return Settings()

# FastAPI: settings = get_settings() in lifespan; Depends(get_settings) if needed
# Production: set APP_DATABASE_URL / APP_API_SECRET via platform; omit env_file or _env_file=None
failure_modes: 1) Missing required env → crash at import time if Settings() at module import before env injected — prefer lifespan/get_settings. 2) extra=forbid + leftover keys in .env → unexpected ValidationError. 3) Nested delimiter splitting field names with underscores (use env_nested_max_split). 4) Windows case-insensitivity surprises for env names. 5) SecretStr logged via debug model_dump. 6) Cached get_settings() not cleared in tests → cross-test pollution. 7) Multiple .env files override order misunderstood. 8) JSON complex env values malformed. 9) secrets_dir path wrong in K8s → silent missing secrets. 10) Shipping .env inside Docker image.
anti_patterns: os.getenv sprinkled without types; dotenv.load_dotenv in library code; mutable global settings object reassigned fields; class Config: env_file=... (V1); defaulting secrets to empty string and continuing; reading secrets from git-tracked files; constructing Settings() inside hot request paths without cache; mixing CLI argparse with ad-hoc env without a single Settings model; storing Solana mainnet seed phrases in .env.
tools: Primary: pydantic-settings (BaseSettings, SettingsConfigDict). Companion: pydantic SecretStr/AnyUrl/PostgresDsn; python-dotenv (transitive). Deploy: Docker/K8s secrets as files → secrets_dir; platform env (Railway, Fly, Render, ECS). Optional extensions: NestedSecretsSettingsSource, SOPS/Vault plugins when org requires. Alternatives: dynaconf, environs, plain os.environ — not greenfield defaults for typed services.
versions_as_of: as_of 2026-07-13: pydantic-settings 2.14.2 (PyPI Jun 2026); requires pydantic v2. Pin pydantic-settings>=2.14,<3 and pydantic>=2.13,<3. Docs: pydantic.dev settings management section.
config_snippets:
# pyproject.toml
[project]
dependencies = [
  "pydantic>=2.13.0,<3",
  "pydantic-settings>=2.14.0,<3",
]

# .env.example (committed, no secrets)
# APP_ENVIRONMENT=local
# APP_DATABASE_URL=postgresql+asyncpg://user:pass@localhost:5432/app
# APP_API_SECRET=replace-me

# Docker: inject env; do not COPY .env
# K8s: secrets_dir='/var/run/secrets/app' with files named like field names

# tests: clear cache
# get_settings.cache_clear()
deprecation_watch: pydantic BaseSettings inside main pydantic package (V1 era) — use pydantic_settings package. class Config on settings. Committing production .env. python-decouple / django-environ for new FastAPI services. Loading secrets from user home files without OS permissions review.
ts_boundary: Next.js uses process.env + validated env helpers (e.g. @t3-oss/env-nextjs / Zod). Do not share Python Settings classes with TS. Document the same logical env names where both talk to Supabase (NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL vs APP_SUPABASE_URL). Service-role keys only on Python/Rust server — never NEXT_PUBLIC_*. BFF should not proxy raw service-role secrets to the browser.
rust_boundary: Rust services use envy/figment/config crates or clap+env. Same 12-factor rule: env at deploy time. Prefer independent Settings per binary. Hand off to Rust when the process is already Rust; do not call Python just for config parsing.
supabase_boundary: SUPABASE_URL + anon key for constrained clients; service_role only in server Settings as SecretStr. Never log service_role. Prefer direct Postgres DSN (asyncpg) for workers when RLS is bypassed intentionally and documented. Align migration env with Supabase CLI locally; production secrets via platform, not .env in repo.
boundary_contracts: Publish .env.example as the human contract. OpenAPI does not include secrets. MCP servers get tool credentials from env the same way. Migrations: DATABASE_URL only. Document required env in deploy-ops checklist. Optional: export JSON Schema of Settings for ops tooling (non-secret fields).
decision_matrix_row: Problem: typed process config from env/secrets → Python pydantic-settings. Problem: Next public/runtime env → TS Zod env module. Problem: systems binary config → Rust figment/envy. Never put secrets in client bundles. Prefer fail-fast Settings over runtime defaulting for security-critical URLs.
threats: Secret leakage via logs, exception messages, model_dump, debug endpoints; .env committed to git; SSRF via unconstrained webhook base URLs in settings; confused deputy with service_role key overuse; supply-chain .env from untrusted templates; world-readable secrets_dir files; test settings accidentally pointed at production DSN.
mitigations: SecretStr; forbid debug routes that dump settings; gitignore .env; pre-commit secret scanners; separate APP_ENVIRONMENT; CI uses ephemeral DSN; secrets_dir permissions 600; never print get_secret_value except to the secret consumer; production _env_file=None; rotate keys on leak; least-privilege DB roles separate from settings validation.
agent_codegen_policy: MUST: BaseSettings + SettingsConfigDict; SecretStr for secrets; env_prefix; get_settings lru_cache; .env.example without real values; frozen=True. MUST NOT: hardcode API keys; commit .env; V1 Config; default secrets to real-looking strings; log full settings; put service_role in client code; invent mainnet key material.
tests_required: Unit: construct Settings with env monkeypatch; missing required field raises ValidationError; SecretStr not equal to raw in repr; nested __ delimiter works; cache_clear between tests. Integration: app lifespan boots with test env. Smoke: production image starts only with required env injected.
ci_gates: No .env secrets in git (gitleaks/trufflehog); ruff+basedpyright; pytest settings tests; optional check that .env.example keys match Settings fields (script).
skill_scan_signals: POSITIVE: BaseSettings, SettingsConfigDict, SecretStr, get_settings, env_prefix, frozen=True, .env.example. NEGATIVE: load_dotenv in library paths, hardcoded sk- or service_role strings, class Config: env_file, print(settings.api_key), Settings() without cache inside request handlers, committed .env with values.
skill_module_bullets:
- Use pydantic-settings BaseSettings + SettingsConfigDict for all service config.
- SecretStr for secrets; fail fast on missing required env.
- get_settings() cached; clear cache in tests.
- .env for local only; production env + secrets_dir; never commit secrets.
- env_prefix + nested __ delimiter; frozen settings.
- Document .env.example as ops contract.
- service_role / DB URLs never in Next public env.
action_items: 1) Add settings skeleton to references/python.md. 2) Scan for load_dotenv and hardcoded secrets. 3) Require .env.example in Python services checklist. 4) Document test cache_clear. 5) Cross-link py-auth-security for key handling.

conflicts_noted: extra default for dotenv can forbid unknown keys and break teams with shared .env files — many codebases set extra='ignore'. Source priority can be customised; default mental model is env over dotenv. Some teams load Settings at import; lifespan loading is safer for certain test/DI setups. CLI features in pydantic-settings are powerful but optional — typer remains fine for ops CLIs.
